# Enny's Kitchen

> Home-cooked Nigerian food, freshly prepared in Surulere, Lagos.

## Website

- Home and menu: https://www.ennyskitchen.com/
- Menu and ordering: https://www.ennyskitchen.com/#menu
- About the kitchen: https://www.ennyskitchen.com/#about
- How to order: https://www.ennyskitchen.com/#how

## Food

The menu includes rice and beans, fried plantain, Egusi soup, Efo Riro, Eba,
Amala and chicken portions. Prices and availability are confirmed when ordering.

## Contact and social

- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/ennyskitchen2/
- Orders: https://wa.me/2348028171608
- Location: 33 Nnobi Street, Opposite Ikate Baptist Church, Kilo Bus-Stop,
  Surulere, Lagos, Nigeria.
